sources.title: Qwen3 4B Thinking 2507 Gemini 2.5 Flash Distill GGUF
sources.snippet: This model is a knowledge distillation model based on the Qwen3-4B architecture, trained with approximately 54.4 million tokens generated by Gemini 2.5 Flash, aiming to integrate the behavior, inference process, and knowledge of Gemini-2.5 Flash into a single dataset.
